newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo names restaurant unit heads.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo names restaurant unit heads.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc on Tuesday named the executives who will run its three fast-food restaurant divisions when they are spun off into a single, separate company later this year.

PepsiCo named Mike Rawlings to run Pizza Hut, Jeff Moody to head KFC and Peter Waller to run Taco Bell. All three will have the title of president and chief concept officer, the company said in a news release.
Heading the combined company will be Chairman/Chief Executive Andrall Pearson and Vice Chairman/President David Novak, who were named to those positions on Monday.
The new company, which has yet to be named, will have more than 29,000 restaurants in 95 countries.
Rawlings has worked with PepsiCo brands as a marketing and advertising executive for 17 years, most recently as president/chief executive of DDB Worldwide Dallas Group and Tracy Locke.
Moody has been at PepsiCo for 10 years, first at Pizza Hut and more recently at PepsiCo Restaurants International.
Waller currently is senior vice president for marketing at Taco Bell. PepsiCo credited him with helping create Taco Bell's current turnaround strategy.
